# Merkava Input Architecture Delta

The Awtsmoos does not ask one class to become a crowded palace;
Awtsmoos.com lets each covenant receive its own vessel so documentation may deepen while source remains spacious.

## New revelation after direct failure reproduction

The baseline verification passes 99/99, yet the exact production constructor wiring fails on keyboard input with:

`TypeError this.actions.reversed is not a function`

The existing suite therefore lacks a direct input-contract test.

## Why the first final plan needs one refinement

`MerkavaApp.js` already sits at 117 lines. Adding the method-level JSDoc and explicit dependency boundaries required by the new code standard would force either compression or a line-limit violation. Neither is acceptable.

Therefore input/application composition should split further instead of reducing documentation.

## Additional modules

- `src/app/MerkavaInterfaceActions.js`
  - builds the HUD-facing action object from one MerkavaApp;
  - keeps interface callback construction out of the app class;
  - each callback name remains explicit and testable.

- `test/inputController.test.mjs`
  - permanently reproduces the previously hidden constructor/API failure;
  - verifies keyboard lane movement, bounded lanes, pointer lane selection, ability/pause commands, optional reversal predicate, and disconnect lifecycle.

## Input API names

The new adapter will use descriptive domain methods instead of ambiguous verbs:
- `currentLane()`
- `chooseLane(lane)`
- `controlsReversed()`
- `activateAbility()`
- `togglePause()`

The adapter owns mutable GameState access. InputController never receives GameState directly again.

## Reversal behavior

Current gameplay contains a boss attack string named `reverse`, but no implemented state flag or modifier that actually reverses controls. Do not invent a new gameplay rule during an architecture repair. `MerkavaInputActions` therefore accepts an optional reversal predicate and defaults to `false`. Future boss/modifier work can inject the predicate without editing InputController.

## App dependency vessel

`MerkavaApp` preserves zero-argument construction, but its constructor will accept an optional object with:
- document target;
- keyboard target;
- systems factory.

All existing runtime and browser diagnostics continue to work, while tests and future surfaces can inject controlled vessels.

## No behavior changes beyond the bug repair

Campaign, save schema, combat, economy, route logic, renderer output, and boss rules remain untouched.
